profile.headline: Software Engineer | React, TypeScript, Node.js | AWS & Cloud-Native | Full Stack
profile.summary:
I’m a mid-level Software Engineer with experience building and supporting production web applications across the stack.

My background is frontend-leaning, with deep experience in React and TypeScript, but I regularly work across APIs, cloud services, and infrastructure. In my most recent role at Sovrn, I contributed to analytics and commerce tools used by online publishers and owned features end-to-end, from collaborating on UX and data flows to implementing backend services, testing, deploying, and supporting systems in production.

I’m known as a thoughtful collaborator and informal mentor who values clear communication, maintainable code, and improving developer experience. Before transitioning into software engineering, I worked in healthcare and professional education, which strongly influences how I approach reliability, teamwork, and user impact.

I’m currently seeking a remote Software Engineer role at a small- to mid-sized or mission-driven organization where ownership and collaboration are valued.
